symptom: The research-only mapper's uniqueOwn diagnostic collector used a fresh Set with ambient Set.prototype.has/add. A synthetic has() that always returns true erases an invalid decision_reasons warning before mapping and can erase additional feature warnings, changing a mapped record's audit digest while status remains mapped. Node 22.16.0 source-equivalent reproduction confirmed one warning collapsing to zero. No private rows or production execution were involved.
lesson: Indexed own-data diagnostic arrays can still lose warning evidence during deduplication if membership checks rely on mutable Set.prototype.has/add. A mapped status alone does not prove the audit warnings and digest are preserved.
guardrail: Use a null-prototype own-data dictionary to deduplicate warning strings, with indexed descriptor reads and appendOwn writes. Regression-test malformed reason JSON plus feature warnings and unchanged mapped digest under reversible Set.prototype.has/add overrides. This does not authenticate sources or authorize production.
